producer_report.summary: I created CHANGELOG.md at the repository root in Keep a Changelog form, with an empty Unreleased section and a 0.1.0 section. The 0.1.0 section has one Added list covering the v0 walking skeleton: the crate layout, the athena commands, the request flow (reader, producer, checks, verifier), landing, the change capability, records, the commit gate, prediction scoring, model-call cost capture, setup.sh, and the docs. Every entry comes from README.md, BRIEF.md, or docs/architecture.md, and I added no features. I also added one row to README.md's Map table that links to the changelog. Nothing else changed. cargo fmt --check and cargo test --locked both pass.
files: README.md (one row added to the Map table linking CHANGELOG.md)
